prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 16:10 landscape
Input images: Image 1 is a structural reference for Conductor's nested project/workspace rail, compact desktop density, and agent-thread proportions only; do not copy its colors, exact components, text, or branding.
Primary request: Design Thread-First Sylph. Preserve the agent narrative as the main surface while making live browser proof persistent instead of hidden in a tab.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed desktop app at the reference image's wide aspect, no device frame, no marketing page.
Structure: Far-left global utility strip. Next, a persistent 300px rail groups each Repository as a parent and nests Workspaces directly beneath with branch icons, state, and +/− change summaries. Never split them into separate sections. Center, about 48% width: long agent transcript, tool actions, file chips, and large composer. Right, about 32%: live browser preview in the upper 60%, with Changes and Checks below; a narrow file/change inspector can replace the lower area. Top breadcrumb names repository then active Workspace. Browser-control state is global and always visible.
Content: Repositories folkhero-web, stett, open-relic; Workspaces Checkout restoration +148 −22, Fix OAuth callback +31, Upgrade billing webhook +82 −9. Active task Polish the onboarding flow. Agent reports browser testing and a corrected 390px flow. Browser shows a tasteful FolkHero onboarding screen. Status Browser checks 4/4, Live, Agent controlling browser. File src/routes/onboarding.tsx.
Style/medium: Contemporary developer application with its own Sylph identity. Soft black application chrome, warm near-white transcript ink, burnt coral active line, cool aqua browser/live state, fine copper separators. Compact workhorse sans and highly readable code face. Square topology with 4px clipped corners, no decorative metaphor.
Composition/framing: Very close to the reference's information architecture but more deliberate: repository parents are stronger, child Workspaces denser, active Workspace gets a coral edge and shallow field. Live preview is persistent and visibly interactive. More breathing room inside the transcript than Conductor.
Text (verbatim where shown): `Sylph`, `Repositories`, `folkhero-web`, `stett`, `open-relic`, `Checkout restoration`, `Fix OAuth callback`, `Upgrade billing webhook`, `Polish the onboarding flow`, `Browser checks 4/4`, `Live`, `Agent controlling browser`, `Changes`, `Checks`, `Review`.
Constraints: Familiar enough to sit beside Conductor, bb, and Diffs; visibly Sylph at a glance. Persistent nested Repository → Workspace rail on the left. Dense, keyboard-first, accessible. No fake claims.
Avoid: copying Conductor's exact brown-black palette, generic VS Code clone, separate Repository and Workspace sections, bento cards, physical metaphor, gradients, glassmorphism, neon, excessive pills, marketing page, device frame, tiny illegible text.
